Summarize Raster Indicator for the General Mosaic Footprint

Source: R/grids.R
d4h_summarize_general.Rd

Computes the overall mean value of raster layers across the entire area of interest (AOI) as a single spatial vector polygon (SpatVector), formatted identically to zonal grid summaries for consistent map plotting.

Usage

d4h_summarize_general(raster_in, exact_boundary = TRUE)

Arguments

raster_in

SpatRaster or character. Input raster layer, stack, or path to file.

exact_boundary

Logical. If TRUE, traces the exact outer boundary of valid non-NA flight data; if FALSE, uses the bounding box extent (default: TRUE).

Value

A SpatVector with a single polygon containing the overall mean value(s).

Examples

# \donttest{
if (interactive()) {
  library(drones4health)
  library(terra)

  # Load environmental index raster
  twi_file <- system.file("extdata", "twi.tif", package = "drones4health")

  # Extract overall mean across the flight mosaic footprint
  gen_summary <- d4h_summarize_general(raster_in = twi_file, exact_boundary = TRUE)
  print(gen_summary)
}
# }
